author: ksmithcredit

item.authorHandle: ksmithcredit
item.caption:
The biggest threat to free and fair elections in America isn’t noncitizens. It’s Donald Trump.

Trump’s DOJ tried to block 20,000 ballots. A federal judge said no. 👇

A federal judge called it “a broad ongoing pattern of attempted election interference by federal officials.” In Alaska, Trump’s DOJ sued to block the Senate result, but only if the Democrat wins. Trump admitted it: “I’m the one that said do it.”

Their “illegal voter” lists keep falling apart. In Nevada, all 185 “confirmed” noncitizens turned out to be US citizens. The DOJ is 0 for 26 in its voter roll lawsuits. He keeps filing because he only needs one win to call it “proof.”

And it’s what he does everywhere: Georgia, Argentina, Honduras, Brazil. When his side loses, it’s rigged. Every time.

So why is a sitting president working this hard to interfere with our elections? And where is Congress? You can blame every House Republican that has enabled this.

This year it’s not Democrat vs. Republican. It’s democracy vs. fascism. Vote Democrat up and down the ballot.

Election Day is Tuesday, Nov 3, 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Find your polling place at votetexas.gov.

#Vote #Texas #Midterms2026 #Democracy #ElectionDay

author: elkingopheadquarters

item.authorHandle: elkingopheadquarters
item.caption:
⏳Final Friday before the Election!🗳

We are pleased to support Michael C. Byrne for the NC Court of Appeals (Seat 1)🇺🇸

Some of you may have had the opportunity to hear from Judge Byrne himself during his stop in Elkin a few weeks ago. He is a strong supporter of our men and women in blue and built a solid reputation for himself during his time representing law enforcement and other public servants. 

He is also no stranger to the Court of Appeals. During his time as an attorney, he litigated more than 20 cases there. As an Administrative Law Judge, he has had 10 of his decisions appealed to the Court of Appeals (spoiler alert: the Court UNANIMOUSLY upheld those decisions!)

10/10 decisions upheld at that level is no easy feat - much less all the decisions being unanimously affirmed! Think he's proved he has what it takes to do the job?

You only have 2 more chances to vote for him!
-Early Voting is Saturday, October 31st 8AM-3PM
-Election Day is Tuesday, November 3rd 6:30AM-7:30PM

🇺🇸Go Vote & FINISH YOUR BALLOT! 🇺🇸 

#ElkinNC #SurryCounty #MichaelByrne #ncCourtofAppeals #GoVote #ElectionDay #EarlyVoting
